transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for coming together on this. Eli, before I make any decision about lending out the PA system for Sunday's wedding reception, I'd like you to restate the exchange offer you're proposing and the pickup and return schedule you have in mind. And June, once Eli has laid that out, I'd like you to confirm the venue's operating limits — specifically the electrical limits — so I know the equipment will be within safe operating conditions. Let's start with you, Eli.
